description:
All 11 component modules that implement `@behaviour OctoPi.TUI.Component` emit a compiler warning at startup:

```
warning: module attribute @impl was not set for function invalidate/1 callback
(specified in OctoPi.TUI.Component). This either means you forgot to add the
"@impl true" annotation before the definition or that you are accidentally
overriding this callback
```

Observed in tmux via `mix pi` on branch opi-0gw.

**Root cause:** opi-0gw.9 added `def invalidate(state), do: state` to 12 component files but omitted `@impl true`. The `Component` behaviour now declares `@callback invalidate(state :: struct()) :: struct()` as optional, so all implementing modules should annotate their stub.

**Affected modules (11 that use `@behaviour OctoPi.TUI.Component`):**
- Container, CustomMessage, Header, LoginDialog, SelectList, SessionSelector, SettingsList, SettingsSelector, SummarizePrompt, TreeSelector, TruncatedText

`Diff` does not implement the behaviour, so it does not need `@impl`.

**Fix:** Add `@impl true` immediately before each `def invalidate(state), do: state` in the 11 affected modules.

**Test:** `mix pi` compiles with zero warnings related to `invalidate/1`.
title: Add @impl true to invalidate/1 stubs in all Component behaviour modules
